scripts.dev: node -e "const {spawn}=require('child_process'); const o={stdio:'inherit',shell:true}; const a=spawn('npm',['run','dev','--prefix','backend'],o); const b=spawn('npm',['run','dev','--prefix','frontend'],o); const stop=()=>{a.kill();b.kill();process.exit()}; process.on('SIGINT',stop); process.on('SIGTERM',stop);"
